# Wire frames of a real DSP 206 (firmware V0104P): request, then the device's answer.
# Extracted from capture_full.pcapng / capture.pcapng of
# https://github.com/FlexiFlizz/t.racks-DSP-control (GPL-3.0, (c) FlexiFlizz).
# The editor addresses the 206 as 0x02 (10 02 00 02 ...), the 206 answers from 0x02.
> 10 02 00 02 01 10 10 03 12
< 10 02 02 00 02 10 19 10 03 08
> 10 02 00 02 01 13 10 03 11
< 10 02 02 00 0e 13 44 53 50 32 30 36 20 56 30 31 30 34 50 10 03 4e
> 10 02 00 02 01 2c 10 03 2e
< 10 02 02 00 07 2c 00 27 0f 00 00 01 10 03 01
> 10 02 00 02 01 22 10 03 20
< 10 02 02 00 15 22 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 10 03 34
> 10 02 00 02 01 14 10 03 16
< 10 02 02 00 02 14 00 10 03 15
> 10 02 00 02 02 29 00 10 03 28
< 10 02 02 00 10 29 00 44 65 66 61 75 6c 74 20 50 72 65 73 65 74 10 03 74
> 10 02 00 02 01 40 10 03 42
< 10 02 02 00 27 40 ab 36 80 a2 36 30 00 00 00 00 00 00 3d 35 05 a2 36 30 ab 36 7f a2 36 30 ab 36 7f a2 36 30 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 10 03 74
> 10 02 00 02 02 27 00 10 03 26
< 10 02 02 00 34 24 00 ff 00 44 65 66 61 75 6c 74 20 50 72 65 73 65 74 49 6e 41 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 63 00 63 00 00 00 78 00 78 00 78 00 78 00 78 00 78 00 78 00 78 00 78 00 10 03 bc
> 10 02 00 02 0a 3d 02 54 45 53 54 00 00 00 00 10 03 20
< 10 02 02 00 01 01 10 03 03
# The 206 also accepts address 0x01 and answers from it:
> 10 02 00 01 0a 33 02 00 50 00 64 00 04 00 00 10 03 0b
< 10 02 01 00 01 01 10 03 00
